scope: Hub bind configuration and HTTP handler, read-only inspection

evidence.finding: HUB_HOST defaults to 127.0.0.1 but is configurable via environment.
ThreadingHTTPServer dispatches GET/POST routes; no HTTP authentication middleware or Authorization validation found in inspected server path.
active process currently has HUB_HOST=127.0.0.1 (value observed, no secrets printed).

current_state.network_mutations: POST handlers exist; no requests issued

findings.statement: Changing HUB_HOST to a non-loopback address changes exposure boundary without a corresponding auth requirement visible in the server.
Loopback is safe only while configuration and process environment remain controlled; the public artifact must not rely on this local assumption.
Active process is currently bound to 127.0.0.1:8900.

recommendations.action: Fail closed if HUB_HOST is not loopback unless explicit authentication/TLS/reverse-proxy mode is configured.
Expose a startup security summary and reject unsafe combinations in production mode.
Add tests for 127.0.0.1 allowed, 0.0.0.0 rejected by default, and authenticated proxy mode explicitly enabled.
Keep network-boundary evidence in deployment manifest and monitor drift in environment variables.
